data.rationale: The proposal captures the true goal and order (Airport tab, pick airport, start and end dates, optional Featured sort), but it adds an unobserved "Search" click, leaves out typing the airport name, and doesn't make the sort option a parameter, so an automation would need guesswork on the typed text and the sort value.
